core_meaning.primary_meaning: Sabah is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Morning”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Sabah corresponds to the Arabic form صَبَاح (Arabic root ص ب ح (ṣ-b-ḥ); صَبَاح (Ṣabāḥ)). Its core sense is sabah; morning. Sabah is Arabic صَبَاح (Ṣabāḥ) 'morning', from the root ص ب ح (ṣ-b-ḥ). The source gloss 'Morning' is consistent.
